order: Apply a second class-border redraw scoped to three findings only. It sits within the prior disagreement ledger and nothing beyond it. Recast one border rule on where the evidence lives, so evidence existing solely while a run is live routes one way, evidence persisting in a readable artifact routes the other, and a symptom being active or recurring is never by itself a running requirement. Mirror that wording in the phase-chain rule and the related border rule. Add a new rule closing the gap between the two ambiguous classes, keyed on whether content was recovered by reconciling a corpus or fixed at intake. Give one rule an explicit unit definition, where an acceptance unit must span two or more components, and add a preamble rule scoping each border rule to its own two classes. Resolve the three flagged items, and record any agreed item that shifts under the tightened rule, leaving validation an open decision for the owner.
claims: All three flagged items resolved determinately under the revised class border: one item went to a running class, one to a fixed class, and one to an evidence class. One previously agreed item was found to shift under the tightened unit rule, and that shift was recorded openly rather than changed silently. No class pair reached the three-item combination trigger, but the two closest pairs stand at exactly two each. The redraw was narrowly scoped, touching 3 files, and validating it was left an open decision for the owner.
